decision: Resume with a repository and toolchain inspection before selecting feature work.
reason: Local main is two commits behind fetched origin/main and the current toolchain cannot run Xcode tests or SwiftLint.

evidence.build: xcodebuild requires full Xcode; active directory is CommandLineTools

scope: No application code changes, merges, releases, or hardware acceptance performed; existing untracked .claude directory preserved.

decision: Fast-forward local main to origin/main at c330be4 as requested.
reason: Resume development on the latest remote code while preserving local documentation and .claude files.
result: Fast-forward succeeded; main matches origin/main. Full Xcode remains required for local builds and tests.

decision: Validate the unchanged latest main using the newly installed Xcode 27.0 toolchain.
result: XcodeGen succeeded, strict SwiftLint passed, and xcodebuild test succeeded with signing disabled.
scope: Toolchain and automated verification only; manual UI and hardware acceptance remain unverified. No application or CI changes.

decision: Inspect Homebrew 7 compatibility without changing the generator or published tap.
findings: url verified: is deprecated in both generator and remote cask; brew info/livecheck warn while brew style passes. Livecheck reports 2026.08.26.0 current. Existing postflight_steps and macOS dependency use modern syntax.
followup: Remove verified: in both generator and tap and extend validation to detect deprecations.
side_effects: brew style bootstrapped Ruby tooling; fully qualified install --dry-run reported trusting the cask. No app reinstall or upgrade performed.

decision: Remove url verified from generator and tap; add developer-mode cask loading to CI after item-scoped trust.
validation: Original cask fails developer mode; corrected generator passes style and loading and matches tap exactly. actionlint and shellcheck pass.
delivery: Separate PRs for app repository and tap; no binary release required.

decision: Keep USB observation metadata-only and make monitoring failure and timestamps explicit.
implementation: Injectable registry adapter; typed status; restart cleanup; manual retry after denial; wake reconciliation; firstSeenAt separate from live connectedAt; no device or volume open operations.
validation: Deterministic adapter tests and sandboxed release acceptance tracked in development runbook. Hardware acceptance is not implied by CI.

decision: Add quiet explicit-opt-in notifications, bounded session history, native login registration and isolated Debug identity.
defaults: New installs notifications/sound/login off; existing notification preference retained; last 50 observations memory-only, serial numbers stripped; one-second fixed grouping window and no hub alerts.
validation: Authorization and login adapters, cancellation and restart tests, and 30-device rendered menu check. Hardware/interactive acceptance limitations documented separately.

decision: Give the menu ScrollView an explicit 520-point viewport and explicitly activate the app before opening native Settings.
reason: Live MenuBarExtra screenshots showed a collapsed viewport despite passing maximum-size tests; Settings could exist without appearing active to the user.
validation: Add a minimum menu-height assertion; native screenshots confirm readable device rows and scroll access to the final device. Alex confirmed Settings appeared in front. Local strict SwiftLint and 122 tests passed.

decision: Expose notification authorization failures and pending state; coalesce concurrent Enable actions.
reason: Native Debug clicks reached macOS but returned an error without a prompt, while the UI discarded the error detail.
validation: Strict SwiftLint and 125 tests passed, including explicit retry and pending-state isolation across restart. Native root cause and successful authorization remain under investigation.
scope: No release work, permission resets, or extra entitlements.

decision: Run interactive Debug acceptance from ~/Applications/usb-boop-dev.app, not temporary DerivedData.
evidence: Identical ad-hoc-signed sandboxed binary returned UNErrorDomain1 from /tmp; after copying to ~/Applications, authorization completed with didGrant1/hasError0 and Alex confirmed success. Native Settings showed enabled.
validation: 126 tests and strict SwiftLint passed. Actual connection-banner delivery remains unverified.
scope: Release and notarization work remain deferred. Preserve the release app and Debug preferences.

decision: Simplify connection banners to device name plus connection/link-speed body; omit USB-generation subtitle.
reason: Alex observed the native notification and found its title, technical subtitle, and device description too verbose.
groups: Count in title; short instruction to open usb-boop for link speeds.
validation: 126 tests and strict SwiftLint passed; updated sandboxed Debug build installed and relaunched from ~/Applications. Revised native banner appearance awaits the next real connection.
icon: Boop and Fast Loop concepts pitched only; no production icon changed.

decision: Adopt Nose Boop as usb-boop's canonical visual identity for future work.
direction: Ginger cat with cream muzzle and coral nose touching a teal USB-C plug on navy; monochrome companion for the menu bar.
implementation: Replace every app icon size, README/site image and favicon; use custom template menu mark; remove retired SVG; preserve approved PNG masters and deterministic sips export script.
validation: 126 tests, strict SwiftLint, ShellCheck, asset dimensions, deterministic exports, and browser visual review passed; installed Debug icon matches built artifact and app relaunched. Native notification icon remains a manual check.
delivery: Local Debug updated. Keep draft PR and public distribution unchanged while Alex continues testing.

decision: Use a solid cat-head silhouette for the menu bar instead of the miniature nose-and-plug scene.
reason: Alex found the first mark cute but difficult to identify at menu-bar size.
scope: Only the monochrome companion is simplified; approved full-color Nose Boop remains unchanged.
validation: Light/dark 22-point preview, rebuilt asset catalog, sandbox signature validation, and local Debug replacement. Menu dismissal report awaits clarification; no speculative lifecycle changes.

decision: Place a USB trident as a transparent cutout inside the menu-bar cat-head silhouette.
reason: Alex explicitly requested the combined symbol to make the app immediately identifiable.
scope: Canonical monochrome menu master and both packaged scales updated; full-color Nose Boop icon remains unchanged.
validation: Actual-size light/dark browser preview and Debug asset build; no new permissions or menu lifecycle changes.

decision: Proceed with squash-merging PR12 to main once all checks on its current head pass.
authorization: Alex explicitly requested Merge to main, superseding the earlier draft hold.
scope: Existing main-branch release automation may run; local notarization of an earlier binary does not cover new CI artifacts.
validation: Gate merge on exact current head/base, terminal checks, mergeability, and review findings. Keep native acceptance limitations separate.
